body.name: Password spraying from outside the network
body.description:
One external source address fails to log in as more than three different users within thirty minutes.

ATT&CK: T1110.003
opentide: 00000000-0000-4000-8003-000000000071

sequences.name: Failed logins from outside
sequences.query:
activity_type:"app-login" AND outcome:"fail"
AND NOT src_ip:[10.0.0.0/8] AND NOT src_ip:[172.16.0.0/12] AND NOT src_ip:[192.168.0.0/16]

case.description: Password spraying from outside the network
